finding: Buy-and-hold Sharpe beat the LLM agents FinMem and FinAgent in every setup; no significant alpha. Too cautious in bull years, too aggressive in bear years.

sample: 20 Dow stocks, Mar-Jun 2025, after model cutoffs
finding: Best agent +2.5% vs buy-and-hold +0.4%; every agent trailed buy-and-hold in the downturn; worse with more stocks.
General leaderboard rank does not predict trading results.

sample: China CSI 300, 2024 to Apr 2026, tickers hidden
finding: 9 of 10 agents had negative stock-selection alpha; returns came from market and momentum exposure.
No directional edge; sizing ignored volatility; many winners turned into losses without a mechanical exit.
Real but short (1-2 day) drift, mostly from negative news; unprofitable at 20 bps costs and decaying each year.
Backtests on dates the model trained on were inflated by up to 67%, most for big famous stocks.

sample: Total return since Apr 2005, partly back-calculated
finding: Nifty200 Momentum 30 about 18.8%/yr and Low Vol 30 about 16.9%/yr vs Nifty 50 about 13.6%/yr; momentum can crash.
